S01E04.title: The One with George Stephanopoulos
S01E04.zh_title: 乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯之夜

words.original: If I were omnipotent for a day, I would want world peace, no more hunger...
words.scene: 大家在咖啡馆讨论如果变得全能会许什么愿望。
words.example: In the story, the wizard was omnipotent and could do anything.

words.original: Would you look at her? She is so peaceful.
words.scene: 瑞秋在沙发上睡着，莫妮卡说她看起来很安详。
words.example: The lake was so peaceful in the early morning.

words.original: It's okay, you just nodded off again.
words.scene: 瑞秋在咖啡馆里不停打瞌睡，朋友们安慰她。
words.example: I nodded off during the boring lecture.

words.original: My grandmother has a new boyfriend, and they're both kind of insecure in bed.
words.scene: 菲比解释自己为什么睡不着，因为奶奶和新男友都很没自信。
words.example: He feels insecure about speaking in public.

words.original: So they're constantly having to reassure each other that they're having a good time.
words.scene: 菲比说奶奶和男友不断互相确认对方是否开心。
words.example: She called to reassure me that everything was fine.

words.original: Look, my first paycheck! Look at the window, there's my name!
words.scene: 瑞秋兴奋地展示自己人生中第一份薪水支票。
words.example: I can't wait to get my paycheck this Friday.

words.original: I wiped tables for it, I steamed milk for it, and it was totally not worth it.
words.scene: 瑞秋抱怨自己擦桌子、热牛奶赚来的工资根本不值得。
words.example: Please wipe the counter after you make dinner.

words.original: Everyone I know is either getting married, or getting pregnant, or getting promoted, and I'm getting coffee!
words.scene: 瑞秋对信用卡客服发泄，说朋友们都在结婚怀孕升职，而她只能端咖啡。
words.example: She was promoted to manager after three years.

words.original: Look at you in the apron. You look like you're in a play.
words.scene: 瑞秋的朋友来咖啡馆看到她穿着围裙当服务生。
words.example: He put on an apron before he started cooking.

words.original: Kiki, you look phenomenal. I mean, you've lost like a ton of weight.
words.scene: 瑞秋的朋友琦琦怀孕，另一个朋友夸她状态非凡。
words.example: The band gave a phenomenal performance last night.

words.original: Guess who my dad's making partner in his firm?
words.scene: 瑞秋的朋友们互相炫耀家里的事业和好消息。
words.example: He became a partner at the law firm this year.

words.original: Well, the biggest news is still you dumping Barry at the altar!
words.scene: 朋友们聊起瑞秋在圣坛前抛弃巴瑞的八卦。
words.example: She dumped her boyfriend after he lied to her.

words.original: Well, the biggest news is still you dumping Barry at the altar!
words.scene: 朋友们聊起瑞秋在婚礼圣坛前逃跑的八卦。
words.example: They exchanged rings at the altar.

words.original: I even do my own laundry.
words.scene: 瑞秋向朋友证明自己独立，说自己甚至自己洗衣服。
words.example: I have to do laundry this weekend.

words.original: I take the dead flowers out of the vase.
words.scene: 瑞秋列举自己在咖啡馆的工作内容，包括清理花瓶里的枯花。
words.example: She put the fresh flowers in a glass vase.

words.original: We thought since Phoebe was staying over tonight we'd have kinda like a slumber party thing.
words.scene: 莫妮卡提议菲比来借住，大家办一个睡衣派对。
words.example: The girls had a slumber party and stayed up all night talking.

words.original: We got some trashy magazines, we got cookie dough, we got Twister...
words.scene: 莫妮卡准备睡衣派对的东西，包括八卦杂志和饼干面团。
words.example: She loves reading trashy magazines at the beach.

words.original: We got some trashy magazines, we got cookie dough, we got Twister...
words.scene: 莫妮卡列举睡衣派对的食物，包括曲奇饼干面团。
words.example: I made pizza dough from scratch last night.

words.original: I brought Operation! But I lost the tweezers, so we can't operate.
words.scene: 菲比带了桌游 Operation，但镊子丢了没法做手术。
words.example: I need tweezers to pull out this splinter.

words.original: They say there's been some unusual activity on your account.
words.scene: 信用卡公司打电话来说瑞秋的账户有异常活动。
words.example: I need to check my bank account balance.

words.original: Oh, bonehead, bonehead! When you do that, you're only hitting yourself.
words.scene: 披萨小弟送错披萨后捶自己头，乔伊说他是笨蛋。
words.example: Don't be such a bonehead—read the instructions first.

words.original: Was he wearing a stunning blue suit and a power tie?
words.scene: 瑞秋幻想乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯穿着帅气的蓝西装。
words.example: You look stunning in that dress.

words.original: White House adviser? Clinton's campaign guy?
words.scene: 大家讨论街对面住的是克林顿的竞选顾问。
words.example: He works as a financial adviser for the company.

words.original: The one with the great hair, sexy smile, really cute butt?
words.scene: 菲比和瑞秋描述乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯迷人的外貌。
words.example: He fell and hurt his butt on the ice.

words.meaning: 预科生风格的，名牌高校的
words.original: I think you have to draw him out. And then when you do, he's a preppy animal.
words.scene: 女孩们幻想乔治·史蒂法诺普洛斯的真实性格。
words.example: He dresses in a classic preppy style with polo shirts.

words.original: One time, he helped me put on my coat, and he was really tender.
words.scene: 莫妮卡回忆乔伊帮她穿外套时很温柔。
words.example: He gave her a tender look before leaving.

words.original: I have a feeling that Chandler is a lot more sophisticated than he seems.
words.scene: 女孩们讨论钱德勒其实比看起来更有深度。
words.example: She has very sophisticated taste in wine and art.

words.original: Where's my puck?
words.scene: 罗斯在冰球比赛后发现自己拿到的冰球不见了。
words.example: The player shot the puck into the goal.

words.original: The guy's a freak. I judge him.
words.scene: 乔伊得知罗斯只和一个女人上过床后觉得他是怪胎。
words.example: Some people call him a freak because he dresses differently.

words.original: Could've played Monopoly, but nooooo.
words.scene: 大家在玩扭扭乐，罗斯抱怨本来可以玩大富翁。
words.example: We spent the whole afternoon playing Monopoly.

expressions.original: See, there's always one guy.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒说如果自己能全能一天，就会让自己永远全能，乔伊吐槽总有这种人。
expressions.example: Every group project has that one person who does nothing—there's always one guy.

expressions.meaning: 你说什么？/请再说一遍？（表示惊讶或不满）
expressions.original: Probably kill myself! ..Excuse me?
expressions.scene: 乔伊误以为 omnipotent 是别的意思，说要自杀，罗斯惊讶地问“什么？”。
expressions.example: Excuse me? I can't believe you just said that.

expressions.meaning: 你怎么了？/你最近怎么回事？
expressions.original: What's going on with you? I got no sleep last night!
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡看到瑞秋状态不好，问她怎么了。
expressions.example: You look tired. What's going on with you?

expressions.original: You know what, I'd better pass on the game.
expressions.scene: 罗斯因为想起和卡罗尔的纪念日，决定不去看冰球赛。
expressions.example: I'll pass on dessert tonight, I'm too full.

expressions.original: The hell with hockey, let's all do that!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒讽刺地说去他的冰球，大家一起去想前妻吧。
expressions.example: The hell with waiting in line—let's go home.

expressions.original: Alright, maybe it'll take my mind off it.
expressions.scene: 罗斯同意去看冰球，希望比赛能让他暂时忘记卡罗尔。
expressions.example: Going for a run helps take my mind off stress.

expressions.original: Do you promise to buy me a big thumb finger? You got it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒答应罗斯会给他买个大手指道具。
expressions.example: Can you help me move this box? You got it.

expressions.original: I wiped tables for it, I steamed milk for it, and it was totally not worth it.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋拿到第一份工资后觉得辛苦工作根本不值得。
expressions.example: The argument got so heated that it just wasn't worth it.

expressions.original: All things considered, you had fun tonight.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒劝罗斯承认，综合来说今晚他还是玩得开心。
expressions.example: All things considered, the party went really well.

expressions.meaning: 谁先找到归谁，后到没得。
expressions.original: Finders keepers, losers weepers.
expressions.scene: 小孩捡到罗斯的冰球不肯还，说先到先得。
expressions.example: I found this dollar on the ground—finders keepers, losers weepers.

S01E05.title: The One with the East German Laundry Detergent

words.original: You just reach in there, there's one little maneuver, and bam, a bra right out the sleeve.
words.scene: 菲比展示她能把胸罩从袖子里抽出来的神奇动作。
words.example: The driver made a quick maneuver to avoid the bicycle.

words.original: There's the horrible awkward moment when you've handed her the note.
words.scene: 钱德勒形容分手时把纸条递给对方的尴尬时刻。
words.example: There was an awkward silence after his joke fell flat.

words.original: I think she'd feel like we're gangin' up on her.
words.scene: 钱德勒担心如果大家一起去和珍妮斯分手，她会感觉被围攻。
words.example: The older kids ganged up on him and took his lunch money.

words.original: You're breaking up with Tony? Yeah, I know, he's sweet, but it's just not fun anymore.
words.scene: 莫妮卡提到自己和托尼分手，瑞秋惊讶。
words.example: She dumped him after three months of dating.

words.original: I don't know if it's me, or his hunger strike, or I don't know.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说和托尼分手可能是因为他的绝食抗议。
words.example: The prisoners went on a hunger strike to demand better conditions.

words.original: Last week you had a wonderful, nutty, chocolatey kind of a cakey pie thing.
words.scene: 顾客在咖啡馆里向瑞秋形容上周吃的坚果巧克力派。
words.example: This cookie has a rich, nutty flavor.

words.original: It's my father. He wants to give me a Mercedes convertible.
words.scene: 瑞秋说爸爸想用奔驰敞篷车诱惑她搬回家。
words.example: He drove down the coast in a red convertible.

words.original: Actually, I got the extended disco version, with three choruses of 'You'll never make it on your own'.
words.scene: 瑞秋形容爸爸又对她长篇大论地说她无法独立生活。
words.example: The movie has an extended version with extra scenes.

words.original: Actually, I got the extended disco version, with three choruses of 'You'll never make it on your own'.
words.scene: 瑞秋用“副歌重复三遍”来形容爸爸的唠叨。
words.example: Everyone sang along to the chorus of the song.

words.original: Wow, being dumped by you obviously agrees with her.
words.scene: 乔伊看到前女友安吉拉变得更漂亮，说被乔伊甩掉显然对她很好。
words.example: This warm weather really agrees with me.

words.original: I don't wanna seem too eager.
words.scene: 乔伊想去和前女友打招呼，但又不想显得太急切。
words.example: The students were eager to hear the exam results.

words.original: That's because I'm wearing a dress that accents my boobs.
words.scene: 安吉拉说自己的裙子很显胸。
words.example: The red scarf accents the color of her eyes.

words.original: Oh, big glamour night. Me and Monica at Laundorama.
words.scene: 瑞秋讽刺地说今晚很精彩，要和莫妮卡去洗衣店。
words.example: The actress brought old Hollywood glamour to the event.

words.original: You wanna hear a freaky coincidence? Guess who's doing laundry there too?
words.scene: 罗斯假装巧合也要去同一家洗衣店，制造和瑞秋独处的机会。
words.example: What a coincidence! I was just thinking about you.

words.original: They're attracted to the dryer sheets, and they're goin' in fine, but they're comin' out all fluffy.
words.scene: 罗斯编造借口说公寓洗衣房的老鼠被烘干机纸吸引，出来变得毛茸茸。
words.example: The kitten was small, white, and fluffy.

words.original: Bob is great. He's smart, he's sophisticated, and he has a real job.
words.scene: 安吉拉夸新男友鲍勃聪明成熟又有正经工作。
words.example: She prefers sophisticated novels to simple love stories.

words.original: You go on three auditions a month and you call yourself an actor?
words.scene: 安吉拉讽刺乔伊一个月只试镜三次还自称演员。
words.example: He has an audition for a movie role next week.

words.original: Not after your cousin who could belch the alphabet.
words.scene: 莫妮卡拒绝乔伊安排的相亲，说上次他表哥会打嗝念字母。
words.example: He drank too much soda and started to belch.

words.original: Angela's different. She's like one of a kind, like a snowflake.
words.scene: 乔伊形容前女友安吉拉像雪花一样独一无二。
words.example: Every snowflake has a unique shape.

words.original: It's laundry. The thinking through is pretty minimal.
words.scene: 罗斯轻描淡写地说去洗衣店不用想太多。
words.example: The damage to the car was minimal.

words.original: Well, you may wanna rethink the dirty underwear.
words.scene: 钱德勒提醒罗斯，瑞秋可能会看到他的脏内衣。
words.example: Make sure you pack enough clean underwear for the trip.

words.original: Oh, and uh, the fabric softener?
words.scene: 钱德勒建议罗斯换种柔顺剂，不要再用Snuggles。
words.example: I always add fabric softener to make my clothes smell fresh.

words.original: What, it says I'm a sensitive, warm kinda guy, you know, like a warm, fuzzy bear.
words.scene: 罗斯解释自己的Snuggles柔顺剂代表他敏感温暖。
words.example: He's very sensitive to other people's feelings.

words.original: Oh yeah, that hug looked pretty brutal.
words.scene: 钱德勒和珍妮斯分手后，朋友们讽刺说那个拥抱看起来很绝情。
words.example: The winter wind was brutal this morning.

words.original: No suds, no save.
words.scene: 洗衣店里一个女人抢了瑞秋的洗衣机，说没有泡沫就不算占位。
words.example: The dishwater was full of suds.

words.original: Oh, hey, uh you must need detergent.
words.scene: 罗斯借给瑞秋自己带的德国洗衣粉。
words.example: I need to buy laundry detergent this weekend.

words.original: Oh God. Oh, am I being like a total laundry spaz?
words.scene: 瑞秋第一次洗衣服，自嘲是不是像个洗衣白痴。
words.example: I felt like a total spaz trying to dance at the party.

words.original: A third for your delicates, and that would be your bras and your under-panty things.
words.scene: 罗斯教瑞秋把贴身精细衣物分开洗。
words.example: This blouse is made of delicate silk.

words.original: Oh God, I'm gonna look like a big marshmallow peep.
words.scene: 瑞秋把白衣服洗成粉红色，觉得自己像棉花糖。
words.example: We roasted marshmallows over the campfire.

words.original: He needed some time to grieve.
words.scene: 钱德勒终于和珍妮斯分手后，需要时间疗伤。
words.example: She took a week off work to grieve for her grandmother.

expressions.text: It's not that big a deal.
expressions.original: Would you let it go? It's not that big a deal.
expressions.scene: 罗斯为一件小事纠结，瑞秋让他别太在意。
expressions.example: I know you're upset, but it's not that big a deal.

expressions.meaning: 让我震惊，让我难以置信
expressions.original: You know what blows my mind? Women can see breasts any time they want.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒感叹女人随时能看到自己的胸，这让他难以置信。
expressions.example: The view from the top of the mountain blew my mind.

expressions.original: How you get any work done is beyond me.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒说女人随时能看到胸，真不懂她们怎么还能工作。
expressions.example: Why he quit his great job is beyond me.

expressions.original: You finally get up the courage to do it, and there's the horrible awkward moment.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒形容分手前要鼓起勇气面对尴尬。
expressions.example: I finally got up the courage to ask her out.

expressions.original: Be a man, just stop calling.
expressions.scene: 罗斯建议钱德勒像个男人一样，直接不再打电话来分手。
expressions.example: Be a man and tell her the truth instead of hiding.

expressions.original: Joey, for all we know this guy could be horribly attractive.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡提醒乔伊，鲍勃说不定其实非常迷人。
expressions.example: For all we know, he might already be married.

expressions.meaning: 快刀斩乱麻，快速解决痛苦的事
expressions.original: It's just like pulling off a Band-aid. Just do it really fast, and then the wound is exposed.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡比喻分手就像快速撕掉绷带，越快越好。
expressions.example: Ending the relationship was hard, but I pulled it off like a Band-aid.

expressions.original: Well, you'll have to wait your turn.
expressions.scene: 急诊室里护士让罗斯排队等候。
expressions.example: Don't push—everyone has to wait their turn.

expressions.original: Now come on, get outta my way.
expressions.scene: 洗衣店里抢推车的女人对瑞秋大喊让开。
expressions.example: Get out of my way or I'll be late for the meeting.

expressions.original: I'm free! I'm free! That oughta do it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒分手后大喊自由，乔伊说这样他应该没事了。
expressions.example: Just add a little salt and that oughta do it.

words.meaning: 即将发生的，迫在眉睫的
words.original: Notice, no fear, no sense of impending doom...
words.scene: 乔伊提醒大家，没看过他演戏的人通常不会有末日将至的恐惧感。
words.example: The dark clouds gave a sense of impending rain.

words.original: The exclamation point in the title scares me.
words.scene: 罗斯说戏剧标题里的感叹号让他害怕。
words.example: She added an exclamation point to show her excitement.

words.original: God. I feel violated.
words.scene: 看完乔伊演的奇怪音乐剧后，罗斯觉得自己被冒犯了。
words.example: I felt violated when someone read my private messages.

words.original: Did anybody else feel they just wanted to peel the skin off their body?
words.scene: 罗斯形容看乔伊演戏时尴尬到想剥掉自己的皮。
words.example: Peel the banana before you eat it.

words.original: Could she be more out of my league?
words.scene: 钱德勒看到剧院里的美女，觉得自己高攀不起。
words.example: She's way out of my league—I doubt she'd go out with me.

words.original: Ross, back me up here. He could never get a woman like that in a million years.
words.scene: 钱德勒想让罗斯帮腔，证明自己配不上那位美女。
words.example: Can you back me up when I tell Mom what happened?

words.original: I'm very very aware of my tongue...
words.scene: 钱德勒紧张地准备上前搭讪，突然非常在意自己的舌头。
words.example: Are you aware that you've been talking for an hour?

words.original: Stand back, everyone. Incoming ego shrapnel.
words.scene: 钱德勒去搭讪美女，罗斯让大家退后，说自尊碎片要来了。
words.example: The explosion left shrapnel embedded in the wall.

words.original: C'mon, you guys, it wasn't that bad. I was the lead.
words.scene: 乔伊为自己辩护，说自己在戏里是主角。
words.example: He plays the lead in the new movie.

words.original: It was better than that thing I did with the trolls, at least you got to see my head.
words.scene: 乔伊比较自己以前演巨魔只露出头的经历。
words.example: The children's book was full of trolls living under bridges.

words.original: She pronounces my name 'Chand-lrr'. 'Chand-lrr'.
words.scene: 钱德勒说奥萝拉把他的名字念成“钱德勒尔”。
words.example: Can you pronounce this French word for me?

words.original: Oh, listen, the usher gave me this to give to you.
words.scene: 剧院引座员给了乔伊一张经纪公司的名片。
words.example: The usher showed us to our seats.

words.original: The Estelle Leonard Talent Agency. Wow, an agency left me its card!
words.scene: 乔伊发现一家经纪公司给他留了名片，非常兴奋。
words.example: She signed with a modeling agency last month.

words.original: You weren't expecting someone so fantastically beautiful.
words.scene: 乔伊见到经纪人埃斯特尔时，她自恋地夸自己美丽。
words.example: The party was fantastically fun.

words.original: No, I wanna go to the top of the Empire State Building and make out.
words.scene: 经纪人埃斯特尔用《西雅图夜未眠》的梗开玩笑说要和乔伊亲热。
words.example: They were making out in the back seat of the car.

words.original: It was unbelievable. I've never met anyone like her.
words.scene: 钱德勒形容和奥萝拉的约会太不可思议了。
words.example: The view from the mountain was unbelievable.

words.original: Oh, I'm sorry, then you're widowed? Hopefully?
words.scene: 钱德勒得知奥萝拉有丈夫后，希望她不是寡妇。
words.example: She was widowed at a young age.

words.original: Sliding your foot so far up my pant leg you can count the change in my pocket?
words.scene: 奥萝拉调情时把脚滑到钱德勒的裤腿上。
words.example: Be careful not to slide on the icy sidewalk.

words.original: This is twisted! How could you get involved with a woman like this?
words.scene: 朋友们得知奥萝拉同时有丈夫和男友后觉得关系太扭曲。
words.example: That's a twisted way to think about friendship.

words.original: I mean, this is every guy's fantasy!
words.scene: 钱德勒认为不用负责又能约会的关系是每个男人的幻想。
words.example: Traveling around the world is his ultimate fantasy.

words.original: Well, y'know, monogamy can be a tricky concept.
words.scene: 罗斯试图从人类学角度解释一夫一妻制很复杂。
words.example: Monogamy is the norm in many cultures.

words.original: I did the windows, I did the floors... I even used all the attachments on the vacuum.
words.scene: 莫妮卡大打扫除，用了吸尘器上的所有配件。
words.example: I need to vacuum the living room before guests arrive.

words.original: I even used all the attachments on the vacuum, except that little round one with the bristles.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说她不知道吸尘器上带鬃毛的圆头配件是干嘛用的。
words.example: The brush has stiff bristles for scrubbing.

words.original: Oh! I-I see you moved the green ottoman.
words.scene: 莫妮卡发现瑞秋挪动了她的绿色脚凳，非常在意。
words.example: He put his feet up on the ottoman.

words.original: Okay, so I'm responsible, I'm organised. But hey, I can be a kook.
words.scene: 莫妮卡承认自己有责任感、有条理，但也想证明自己能随性。
words.example: She's very organized and always finishes her work on time.

words.original: Okay, so I'm responsible, I'm organised. But hey, I can be a kook.
words.scene: 莫妮卡想证明自己不只是整洁有条理，也可以很随性。
words.example: My neighbor is a bit of a kook, but she's harmless.

words.original: Little beads of condensation are inching their way closer and closer to the surface of the wood...
words.scene: 朋友们故意描述冷饮杯上的水珠逼近木桌，刺激莫妮卡。
words.example: Condensation formed on the outside of the cold glass.

words.original: Here. I need to borrow some moisturizer.
words.scene: 乔伊要去演阿尔·帕西诺的屁股替身，来借保湿霜。
words.example: I apply moisturizer every morning to keep my skin soft.

words.original: No, that was clenching.
words.scene: 导演说乔伊在淋浴戏里屁股夹太紧了。
words.example: He clenched his fists in anger.

words.original: Y'know, I've done nothing but crappy plays for six years.
words.scene: 乔伊因为失去电影机会而沮丧，说自己演了六年烂戏。
words.example: The weather was crappy all weekend.

expressions.original: Could she be more out of my league?
expressions.scene: 钱德勒看到一位绝色美女，觉得自己完全配不上她。
expressions.example: That job is way out of my league—I don't have enough experience.

expressions.original: Ross, back me up here.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒想让罗斯帮他证明他追不上那位美女。
expressions.example: Back me up here—wasn't he the one who was late?

expressions.original: Here goes. Yes? Hi... um... okay, next word would be Chandler!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒鼓起勇气上前和奥萝拉搭讪。
expressions.example: I've never sung in public before, but here goes.

expressions.original: Take a load off already, darling. Sit already.
expressions.scene: 经纪人埃斯特尔让乔伊坐下来谈。
expressions.example: You look tired—come in and take a load off.

expressions.original: Once I got on the subway, right, and it was at night, and I rode it all the way to Brooklyn, just for the hell of it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒对奥萝拉讲自己无聊时坐地铁去布鲁克林的故事。
expressions.example: We drove to the beach at midnight just for the hell of it.

expressions.original: It was this perfect evening... more or less.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒形容和奥萝拉的约会大致上很完美。
expressions.example: I've more or less finished the report.

expressions.original: I couldn't do it. Good for you, Joey.
expressions.scene: 乔伊说无法接受和已婚女人约会，莫妮卡夸他做得好。
expressions.example: You got the promotion? Good for you!

expressions.original: There's a theory, put forth by Richard Leakey...
expressions.scene: 罗斯想引用理查德·里奇的理论来解释一夫一妻制。
expressions.example: He put forth a new plan at the meeting.

expressions.original: After all your years of struggling, you've finally been able to crack your way into showbusiness.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒讽刺乔伊经过多年努力终于“打入”演艺圈。
expressions.example: It took years to crack his way into the fashion industry.

expressions.original: Look at it this way: you dumped her.
expressions.scene: 罗斯安慰钱德勒，让他换个角度想，其实是他甩了奥萝拉。
expressions.example: Look at it this way—you learned something valuable from the experience.

words.original: The entire city is blacked out!
words.scene: 全城突然大停电，大家在莫妮卡家惊讶地发现整个城市一片漆黑。
words.example: The storm caused a blackout that lasted six hours.

words.original: Who am I gonna meet in a blackout? Power company guys? Eligible looters?
words.scene: 钱德勒被困在ATM厅，抱怨停电时遇不到合适的单身汉。
words.example: Are you eligible for the employee discount?

words.original: Who am I gonna meet in a blackout? Power company guys? Eligible looters?
words.scene: 钱德勒被困时自嘲说只能遇到趁火打劫的人。
words.example: Looters broke into stores during the riot.

words.original: I am trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre!
words.scene: 钱德勒激动地发现自己和名模吉尔·古达克被困在ATM前厅。
words.example: The vestibule of the building had marble floors.

words.original: Is it a vestibule? Maybe it's an atrium.
words.scene: 钱德勒纠结自己和吉尔被困的地方到底叫前厅还是中庭。
words.example: The hotel lobby had a beautiful indoor atrium.

words.original: Oh yeah, that is the part to focus on, you idiot!
words.scene: 钱德勒内心责骂自己，居然在纠结是vestibule还是atrium。
words.example: I felt like an idiot when I realized I was wrong.

words.original: And officiating at tonight's blackout, is Rabbi Tribbiani.
words.scene: 乔伊戴上犹太小帽，假装拉比主持停电夜。
words.example: The mayor will officiate at the opening ceremony.

words.original: Well, Chandler's old roommate was Jewish, and these are the only candles we have.
words.scene: 乔伊解释为什么点犹太教的光明节蜡烛。
words.example: She celebrates Jewish holidays with her family.

words.original: Ugly Naked Guy lit a bunch of candles.
words.scene: 大家看到对面丑陋裸男点了很多蜡烛。
words.example: We lit candles during the blackout.

words.original: The blackout's scaring him.
words.scene: 瑞秋和妈妈说大停电把家里的狗德克斯特吓坏了。
words.example: Don't shout, you'll scare the baby.

words.original: I was the last one to know when Chandler got bitten by the peacock at the zoo.
words.scene: 瑞秋举例说自己总是最后知道事情，比如钱德勒被孔雀咬。
words.example: The peacock spread its colorful tail feathers.

words.original: I was the last one to know when you had a crush on Joey when he was moving in.
words.scene: 瑞秋揭发莫妮卡曾经暗恋刚搬来的乔伊。
words.example: She had a crush on her classmate all through high school.

words.meaning: 阴森的，令人毛骨悚然的
words.original: Kinda spooky without any lights.
words.scene: 蜡烛燃尽后屋里一片漆黑，菲比说有点恐怖。
words.example: The old abandoned house looked really spooky.

words.original: OK, guys, guys? I have the definitive one.
words.scene: 大家在模仿恐龙声音，有人说自己的最逼真。
words.example: This is the definitive guide to Italian cooking.

words.original: Barry wouldn't even kiss me on a miniature golf course.
words.scene: 瑞秋抱怨前男友巴瑞连在迷你高尔夫球场上都不肯亲她。
words.example: The museum has a miniature model of the city.

words.original: Passion is way overrated.
words.scene: 罗斯劝瑞秋说激情被高估了，信赖和安全更重要。
words.example: In my opinion, that restaurant is overrated.

words.original: Well, in the case of my ex-wife, lesbianism.
words.scene: 罗斯开玩笑说自己的前妻让他得到了“女同性恋主义”。
words.example: He remains friends with his ex-wife.

words.original: Well, in the case of my ex-wife, lesbianism.
words.scene: 罗斯用前妻卡罗尔的例子调侃激情消退后剩下的是什么。
words.example: The novel explores themes of identity and lesbianism.

words.original: I'm laying the groundwork.
words.scene: 罗斯说自己正在慢慢为追求瑞秋打基础。
words.example: We need to lay the groundwork before starting the project.

words.original: Every day I get just a little bit closer to... Priesthood!
words.scene: 乔伊嘲笑罗斯再不行动就要成神父了。
words.example: He decided to enter the priesthood after college.

words.original: This is running fingers through your hair. Now this is a tousle.
words.scene: 乔伊教罗斯区分“捋头发”和“弄乱头发”的亲昵程度。
words.example: She tousled his hair affectionately.

words.original: The wine? The candles? The moonlight?
words.scene: 乔伊提醒罗斯现在气氛正好，有酒、蜡烛和月光。
words.example: We walked along the beach in the moonlight.

words.original: Um, is it sugarless? Sorry, it's not. Oh, then no thanks.
words.scene: 吉尔请钱德勒吃口香糖，钱德勒先问是否无糖。
words.example: I prefer sugarless gum because it's better for my teeth.

words.original: Gum would be perfection.
words.scene: 钱德勒紧张地改口说口香糖简直是完美选择。
words.example: The dessert was absolute perfection.

words.original: I loathe myself.
words.scene: 钱德勒说完“口香糖是完美选择”后痛恨自己。
words.example: I loathe waking up early on cold mornings.

words.original: During a blackout? He'd get trampled!
words.scene: 菲比担心停电时把猫放在走廊会被踩到。
words.example: The crowd almost trampled the small dog.

words.original: Mon, wanna go for a ride in my racecar?
words.scene: 乔伊开玩笑邀请莫妮卡坐他的赛车，还炫耀自己的胳膊。
words.example: The racecar sped around the track.

words.original: What next? Blow a bubble. A bubble's good. It's got a boyish charm.
words.scene: 钱德勒想通过吹泡泡展现大男孩魅力。
words.example: The kids love to blow soap bubbles in the park.

words.original: Oh my God! And now you're choking.
words.scene: 钱德勒吹泡泡失败，把吉尔给的口香糖吞下去噎到了。
words.example: He started to choke on a piece of bread.

words.original: I know it's totally superficial and we have absolutely nothing in common.
words.scene: 瑞秋承认自己喜欢保罗只是表面上的吸引，两人连语言都不通。
words.example: Their friendship was based on superficial similarities.

expressions.original: The entire city is blacked out!
expressions.scene: 全城突然大停电，大家在公寓里望向窗外。
expressions.example: The neighborhood blacked out during the thunderstorm.

expressions.original: I'm trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒兴奋又紧张地告诉朋友他和名模被困在ATM厅。
expressions.example: We were trapped in the elevator for twenty minutes.

expressions.original: Jill says vestibule... I'm going with vestibule.
expressions.scene: 吉尔说那个地方叫vestibule，钱德勒决定就用这个词。
expressions.example: I'll go with the blue shirt—it matches your eyes.

expressions.original: You'd better act surprised.
expressions.scene: 乔伊泄露了罗斯要给莫妮卡办惊喜派对，让莫妮卡假装惊讶。
expressions.example: I already know about the gift, but I'll act surprised.

expressions.original: I'm always the last one to know everything.
expressions.scene: 菲比抱怨自己总是最后一个知道朋友们的秘密。
expressions.example: I was the last one to know about their engagement.

expressions.original: I was the last one to know when you had a crush on Joey when he was moving in.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋说出莫妮卡曾经暗恋乔伊的秘密。
expressions.example: She had a crush on him since freshman year.

expressions.meaning: 朋友区（只能做朋友，无法发展成恋人）
expressions.original: Because you waited too long to make your move, and now you're in the friend zone.
expressions.scene: 乔伊告诉罗斯，因为他迟迟没有行动，已经被瑞秋当成朋友了。
expressions.example: He's been in the friend zone for years and can't escape.

expressions.original: Because you waited too long to make your move, and now you're in the friend zone.
expressions.scene: 乔伊批评罗斯没有主动追求瑞秋。
expressions.example: If you like her, you should make a move before someone else does.

expressions.original: What's messing you up? The wine? The candles? The moonlight?
expressions.scene: 乔伊问罗斯在这么好的气氛下还在犹豫什么。
expressions.example: Don't mess up this opportunity—it's important.

expressions.meaning: 心里记下，暗自提醒自己
expressions.original: Mental note: If Jill Goodacre offers you gum, you take it.
expressions.scene: 钱德勒后悔拒绝了吉尔的口香糖，在心里提醒自己下次一定要接受。
expressions.example: Mental note: never leave the house without an umbrella.
